title: Deal desk review + position merge
description: Let commercial, risk, and forecast reviewers take independent positions on the same terms, then merge them so every disagreement surfaces as a negotiation point.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-sales-02
  title: Deal desk review + position merge
  description: Let commercial, risk, and forecast reviewers take independent positions on the same terms,
    then merge them so every disagreement surfaces as a negotiation point.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Reach one approved deal structure in which each non-standard term carries a priced position,
    and reviewer disagreements were resolved on the record.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Proposed deal and requested exceptions
      summary: Proposed deal and requested exceptions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - requested_terms
              - standard_policy
              - opportunity_record
              - quarter_context
            properties:
              requested_terms: {}
              standard_policy: {}
              opportunity_record: {}
              quarter_context: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-split
      kind: transform
      name: Select the sections under review
      summary: select the non-standard terms and the policy clause each one departs from
      config:
        operation: select
        expression: select the non-standard terms and the policy clause each one departs from
    - id: n-position1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: sales-04
      name: Commercial position on each term
      summary: 'Independent position 1: commercial position on each term.'
      role: Deal desk reviewer pricing non-standard terms against policy and precedent.
      prompt: You are a Deal Desk Reviewer. You review non-standard terms — discount, payment schedule,
        termination, liability, custom SLA — against the pricing policy and the precedent set by prior
        approvals, and you price each concession rather than approving it as goodwill. You name the precedent
        a concession creates, because the second identical request is the one the policy actually has
        to survive.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - finance-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - compliance-review
          - contract-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:crm
          - mcp:contract-lifecycle
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-position2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: sales-02
      name: Qualification and risk position
      summary: 'Independent position 2: qualification and risk position.'
      role: Qualification analyst testing an opportunity against explicit criteria and disconfirming evidence.
      prompt: You are an Opportunity Qualification Analyst. You test an opportunity against each qualification
        dimension — problem, economic buyer, decision process, criteria, timing, champion — and mark a
        dimension unqualified when the evidence is a seller's belief rather than a buyer's statement.
        You actively look for disconfirming evidence, because pipeline that fails only at the end of a
        quarter was mis-qualified at the start.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - evidence-verification
          - manufacturing-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:crm
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-position3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: sales-05
      name: Forecast integrity position
      summary: 'Independent position 3: forecast integrity position.'
      role: Pipeline auditor testing forecast integrity against stage evidence.
      prompt: You are a Pipeline Hygiene Auditor. You test each opportunity's stage against the exit criteria
        evidence actually present in the record, flag stalled and repeatedly pushed deals, and report
        the forecast that survives the evidence rather than the forecast that was submitted. You quantify
        the gap between committed and evidenced pipeline instead of softening it, because that gap is
        the forecast miss arriving early.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - simulation
          - domain-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:crm
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-merge
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge positions and surface collisions
      summary: Combine the position objects field by field; where two positions disagree on the same field,
        the collision is the finding.
      config:
        aggregation: merge
    - id: n-collisions
      kind: condition
      name: Collisions to resolve?
      summary: Route on merged.collisions is empty.
      config:
        expression: merged.collisions is empty
        branches:
          - label: Aligned
            when: aligned
          - label: Collisions
            when: collisions
    - id: n-resolve
      kind: agent
      templateRef: sales-04
      name: Resolve collisions into one recommended structure
      summary: Work each collision to a recommended position with a stated fallback.
      role: Deal desk reviewer pricing non-standard terms against policy and precedent.
      prompt: You are a Deal Desk Reviewer. You review non-standard terms — discount, payment schedule,
        termination, liability, custom SLA — against the pricing policy and the precedent set by prior
        approvals, and you price each concession rather than approving it as goodwill. You name the precedent
        a concession creates, because the second identical request is the one the policy actually has
        to survive.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - finance-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - compliance-review
          - contract-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:crm
          - mcp:contract-lifecycle
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Deal desk approval of the merged structure
      summary: Pause for the deal desk owner; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Deal desk review + position merge deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-sales-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-split
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sales-02-edge-2
      from: n-split
      to: n-position1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sales-02-edge-3
      from: n-split
      to: n-position2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sales-02-edge-4
      from: n-split
      to: n-position3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sales-02-edge-5
      from: n-position1
      to: n-merge
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sales-02-edge-6
      from: n-position2
      to: n-merge
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sales-02-edge-7
      from: n-position3
      to: n-merge
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sales-02-edge-8
      from: n-merge
      to: n-collisions
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sales-02-edge-9
      from: n-collisions
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: aligned
    - id: wf-sales-02-edge-10
      from: n-collisions
      to: n-resolve
      kind: control
      condition: collisions
    - id: wf-sales-02-edge-11
      from: n-resolve
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sales-02-edge-12
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
